verdict.rationale: Casium documents an organization-side offering: a dedicated attorney and case team, attorneys who file the company's visas, and a single view of compliance, billing and reporting across 90 countries. That is a real employer-side sponsorship service. However, the evidence never names H-1B transfers, H-1B registration filing as a service, LCA compliance, or specific employer paperwork. The H-1B guide only advises employers on lottery timing. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration and transfer service, LCA preparation and public-access-file compliance, enumerated employer paperwork (e.g., I-129 support letters), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, the provider supports the company side of sponsorship — H-1B transfers and registrations, LCA compliance, and the employer paperwork — documented as a service

citations.quote: Best-in-class attorneys file your visas, and one platform shows you exactly where every case stands.
One source of truth for compliance, billing, and reporting.
One attorney and case team who own your account, not a rotating queue.
Casium gives your team a dedicated attorney, software built for immigration, and a live view of your entire program.
